audit.whatIsWrong: This side's chart read Ziggs, Skill, Skill, Skill, Skill, Skill, Ziggs, which disagrees row-for-row with the already-audited mirror and hands Ziggs the two-item row that Urgot actually owns.
audit.why: audits/top/urgot__ziggs.json settled all seven rows as Skill, Ziggs, Urgot, Urgot, Urgot, Urgot, Urgot. Mirrored to this side the labels are identical and the ratings invert.
audit.corrected: Rows realigned in both layers to Skill, Ziggs, Urgot, Urgot, Urgot, Urgot, Urgot with ratings 5/7/4/4/3/3/3, and every why rewritten to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was written as a Ziggs spike ('Mega Inferno Bomb online') with no mention that the same level gives Urgot Fear Beyond Death, and the two-item row claimed Ziggs takes over.
audit.why: Fear Beyond Death is 100/85/70s at 2500 range with an execute threshold and hard CC; Mega Inferno Bomb is 120/95/70s. His R is the shorter cooldown and it converts your chip into his kill, so level 6 is his stage, not yours.
audit.corrected: phases[4].why and phases[6].why rewritten to name Fear Beyond Death's range and the execute line, and to state that two items is his duel, not yours.

audit.whatIsWrong: Disdain was described only as 'his flip engage' — no cooldown, no shield, no mention that it throws you toward Purge range. Purge's range and Corrosive Charge's cooldown appeared nowhere.
audit.why: Riot kit: Disdain is 16/15.5/15/14.5/14s at 475 range and shields him while he charges; Purge is only 490 range and its cooldown falls 12/9/6/3/0 by rank, so being flipped into it is the whole loss condition. Corrosive Charge is 10/9.5/9/8.5/8s at 800 range with a slow.
audit.corrected: dosFull[2].d, dontsFull[0].d, dontsFull[1].d, phases[0].why and whys[2] now carry those numbers and the flip-into-Purge sequence.

audit.whatIsWrong: packet.defects: no cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere, sequencingCues 0.
audit.why: The most punishable cooldown is Disdain at 16s rank 1 — a spent flip is the only safe step-up window in the lane.
audit.corrected: dosFull[2].d now reads as a concrete wait-for-X line built on the 16s number.

edits.before: Q bombs out-range every melee tool in the game — chunk Urgot on every last-hit attempt, but respect early minion aggro.
edits.after: Q out-ranges him, but Corrosive Charge reaches 800 and slows — chunk his last-hits, then step out of the splash.

edits.before: Mega Inferno Bomb online — any chipped target or crashing wave is now your gold. Hold it for the sub-60% HP window.
edits.after: Fear Beyond Death reaches 2500 and executes — stay above the line; your R (120s) answers waves, not his all-in.

edits.before: Shadowflame + Torch makes the full rotation lethal, but the map matters more — rotate R to sieges and skirmishes.
edits.after: At two items his E shield and R execute still win a duel — don't take one. Siege with R and clear from max range.

edits.before: You out-range Urgot's Q and W at level 1, poking for free.
edits.after: You out-range his Q, but Corrosive Charge trades back at 800.

edits.before: Level 2 he still can't reach you, so your Short-Fuse pokes land safely.
edits.after: Level 2 he can't reach you; Short Fuse pokes land before Disdain.

edits.before: Level 3-4 your minefield zones his step-ups and you keep the range lead.
edits.after: Disdain (16s) lands at 3 — one flip and Purge shreds you at 490.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 hold even-to-yours before his kit fully comes online.
edits.after: Purge's cooldown drops per rank; his stick-time only grows here.

edits.before: At 5 his E flip lets him close the gap and turn trades in his favor.
edits.after: Fear Beyond Death at 2500 range executes you out of poke range.

edits.before: His level-6 R execute plus first-item stats give him the kill threat here.
edits.after: His first-item stats plus W uptime let him fight straight through poke.

edits.before: By two items your range and burst re-establish control and beat his DPS.
edits.after: At two items his E shield plus execute still wins the duel — siege.

edits.before: Urgot spends Disdain (Flip) early — the closest thing this matchup has to a guarantee.
edits.after: Disdain is down 16s at rank 1 — that spent flip is your only free step-up window.

edits.before: That’s Urgot’s bread-and-butter play — deny it and they run out of answers.
edits.after: Disdain shields him and throws you back into Purge at 490 — never stand in it.

edits.before: Your Satchel is your Flash — burning it for damage leaves you naked for twenty seconds.
edits.after: Satchel is your Flash — spend it for damage and you are naked for 20s at rank 1.

notes: Chart taken from the already-audited mirror (audits/top/urgot__ziggs.json), not re-derived. Note the tension the user may want to resolve: this side's packet reports 57.14% for Ziggs on only 7 games while the mirror worked from 697 games, and the mirror's chart gives Urgot five of seven stages. I followed the mirror as instructed. I did NOT repeat the mirror's dropped claim that Fear Beyond Death executes through Satchel knockback — unverified.
